Asymmetric framing with the hero unit off-center on the left, leaving generous negative space in the shadowed garage interior on the right. Bone white, charcoal, and slate gray palette with the warm amber contrast. Long-exposure calm, crisp atmospheric depth, no moving figures, fine film grain, no text or logos.
